brief:
Akihiro Seta, director of health operations at the UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees, warned that humanitarian and health conditions in Gaza are deteriorating rapidly, Shehab Wire reported. Seta said the territory is increasingly becoming a place where human life is impossible to sustain.

The health official's assessment reflects deepening concerns among international agencies about conditions across the besieged enclave.

title: UNRWA health chief warns Gaza becoming uninhabitable
